text:
alex: paging: saw a P1 for high p99 token latency hitting customers in eu-west ~10m ago. incident-bot created INC-7241. primary=alex, secondary=maria. briefly summarizing current state and what's in-flight

incident-bot: Incident INC-7241 created by latency-alert (route: /v1/generate). Severity: P1. Pager duty: paged oncall at 02:13 UTC. Alert: p99 gen latency > 2s for 5m.

maria: I jumped in. Root cause looks like a KV cache eviction storm after a burst of long prompts. Cache miss rates spiked to ~86% on primsec pool; fallback to slower exec path. Customers impacted: a handful of high-traffic tenants see >2s p99.

sam: Noted customer list: org-8472, org-9901, org-1123 (high-traffic). I've DM'd account execs and put a short note in status page.

lee: Actions I'm doing now: 1) scaling primsec pool +20% (reserved nodes), 2) enabling short-term read-only fallback for embeddings route to reduce write contention, 3) prewarming KV cache shards for hot prefixes. Will post commands.

lee: kubectl patch deploy primsec-inference --patch '{"spec":{"replicas":10}}'  # scaling, runbook step 3.

alex: Good. Also enabling model-variant fallback to quantized-8 for non-critical tenants to reduce latency and memory pressure. Doing this via routing policy in console.

maria: Observability notes: p50 unaffected, p95 up ~200ms, p99 down from 2.4s to 1.9s after initial scale + cache prewarm. Still oscillating. Watch for eviction TTLs.

ops-bot: Autoscaler triggered: added 2 nodes to primsec-gpu-pool (scale-up started). Estimated ready in ~90s.

sam: Customer comms: org-1123 replied they see degradation but can tolerate short windows, org-8472 flagged elevated errors on chat completions (rate-limited by client). I'm tracking with them.

alex: Coverage notes for handing off the shift in ~45m: primary will be maria -> then lee if page. Secondary is sam. If primsec saturates, fall back to the secondary region (us-east) routing policy: route: /v1/generate -> model: redwood/xsmall-quantized (fallback) with traffic cutover. Runbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/kv-eviction-and-latency (see section "fast mitigation").

maria: Open tasks for next oncall: 1) monitor eviction_rate metric > 50/s -> trigger cache flush mitigation; 2) ensure primsec pool targets hit 10 replicas; 3) keep quantized fallback policy enabled for 30m then re-evaluate.

lee: Possible coverage gap: eu-west spare capacity is low due to other scheduled jobs. If p99 re-surge, we may need to temporarily pause non-critical batch jobs in eu-west (ticket created: infra-6147).

alex: Logging to add to incident: commands run, scaling events, routing changes, and customer comms. I'll create the incident timeline in the tracker.

maria: Temporary runbook snippet I'm adding here for the next shift (copy/paste):

```
# quick mitigation steps (short list)
1. Check metric: primsec.kv_cache.eviction_rate
2. If >50/s -> run: curl -X POST "https://internal-api/ops/cache/flush?shard=hot"
3. Scale primsec pool: kubectl patch deploy primsec-inference --patch '{"spec":{"replicas":<target>}}'
4. Enable routing fallback: POST /api/routing/policies {"route":"/v1/generate","fallback_model":"redwood/xsmall-quantized","duration_min":30}
5. Notify account leads and update status page
```

maria: I'm leaving detailed logs in the incident doc. Handing primary to lee at shift swap at 03:00 UTC. lee will be primary, sam remains secondary. If any pages escalate to SRE-lead, escalate per PD policy.

lee: Got it. I'll monitor the eviction_rate dashboard and leave a watch for autoscaler events. If we see 2 consecutive minutes of p99 >2s, I'm escalating and will start routing cutover.

incident-bot: NOTE: INC-7241 updated. Status: mitigation in progress. Assigned: lee (primary after 03:00 UTC), sam (secondary).

sam: I'll keep the customer comms and status page updated. Adding troubleshooting snippet: to fetch hot prefixes and top keys: `redis-cli --bigkeys` then `redis-cli --scan --pattern "hot:*" | xargs -n1 redis-cli get`.

alex: Thanks everyone. If anything changes before handoff ping @here. Leaving a short checklist in the incident doc: scale applied, fallback enabled, cache prewarm started, customer comms live.

lee: Acknowledged. Taking over at 03:00 UTC. I'll post a short update 10m after the handoff. :thumbsup:
